response.overview: On the outskirts of the village, waiting for the last bus to Budapest, Márk is getting ready for college, while Dóra stays home to work at the factory. Their tense farewell takes a drastic turn when it turns out that she secretly changed his college passwords to prevent him from leaving. As their future hangs in the balance, one final, shocking piece of news permanently alters the course of both their lives.
response.title: Az utolsó busz
